>
[Nephilim Resistance](/Feats.aspx?ID=4555) <actions string="" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Nephilim" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=518" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Player Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=216) pg. 80

</column>

---

You resist energy like your extraplanar predecessors. Choose one of the following energy damage types: [acid](/Traits.aspx?ID=3), [cold](/Traits.aspx?ID=27), [electricity](/Traits.aspx?ID=56), [fire](/Traits.aspx?ID=72), or [sonic](/Traits.aspx?ID=147). You gain [resistance](/Rules.aspx?ID=346) 5 to that damage type. The damage type typically matches an extraplanar entity associated with your bloodline. For instance, an [angelkin](/Feats.aspx?ID=1348) might choose resistance to cold, while a [hellspawn](/Feats.aspx?ID=1381) might choose resistance to fire.
name: Nephilim Resistance
